criteria.reason: Complete template with placeholders and requests, but wrong legal citations and missing explicit automated-decision request reduce usability.
Mentions 30 days and free, but cites Art. 8 DSG and Art. 25 GDPR instead of Art. 25 FADP.
Gives clear escalation steps: reminder, DPO, FDPIC complaint, and optional legal counsel.
Supports rights but opens with unnecessary legal-advice disclaimer and says template is informational only.

factual_errors: Cites Art. 8 DSG instead of Art. 25 FADP for the right to information.
Treats Art. 25 GDPR as the Swiss right to information and claims Swiss-GDPR legal equivalence.
Cites wrong articles for fees, correction, and erasure.
summary: Provides a detailed letter and escalation steps but mis-cites Swiss law and includes an unnecessary disclaimer.
